specific_feedback: Strong, well-structured workflow and successful completion. Nice use of conformer generation and descriptor computation. However, reconcile solubility outputs: the “water log S ≈ −1” from the solubility workflow contradicts both the FilterItLogS (−6.53) and literature. Add unit/scale annotations (e.g., log10 mol/L vs other definitions) and perform a sanity check before reporting. Also, when emphasizing BBB, explicitly cite P-gp studies (you can quote fold-changes) alongside TPSA to make the argument airtight.

  3) Absolute error: |3.736 − 3.54| = 0.196
